达门从容转头，坦然迎上作家探究的目光，眼底澄澈无波，没有丝毫闪躲，神情坦荡淡然，看不出半分情绪起伏。他语气平淡无澜，平静地应声回应：“没错。”顿了顿，他神色淡漠地补充道，“但这些可供调动的人力，廉价且充裕，随处可得，就算尽数投入，也半点不值得可惜。”
两人身形对峙、言语交锋的短暂间隙，注意力全然锁定在彼此对话中的达门，丝毫没有察觉身侧之人暗藏的动作。作家趁着达门目光相对、心神专注的瞬间，身形极其细微地侧身贴近冰凉刺骨的金属实验台，台面常年浸润在药剂与低温中，泛着凛冽的寒意。他的指尖动作娴熟至极，轻得几乎没有半点动静，悄悄捏起一只口径细密、完全密封的细颈玻璃瓶，又顺手抽出一方干净柔软的纯白手帕，指腹稳稳按住瓶身，微微倾斜，将瓶中无色无味、澄澈透明的特殊液体，缓缓、均匀地倾倒在手帕的布面之上。
整套动作行云流水，轻柔又隐秘，手腕转动的弧度极小，身姿遮挡了所有异动，全程静谧无声，没有发出一丝一毫的磕碰与响动，完美掩去了所有痕迹，彻底骗过了身侧的达门。
达门依旧毫无察觉身旁的隐秘异动，心神全然沉浸在自己筹谋已久的改造计划之中。他眉眼冷峻，语气带着一丝绝对不容置喙的冷静，条理清晰地娓娓道出这场实验的核心规则：“我们深入失事沉船的海域搜救幸存者，深海环境瞬息万变，危险丛生，若是行动晚一步，从冰冷海底打捞上来的，就再也不会是鲜活的人，只会是一具具冰冷僵硬、毫无生机的尸体。”
他微微垂眸，眼底掠过一丝偏执的狂热，语气笃定而冰冷，道出了这场计划的最终目的：“而我们，会拼尽全力抢在死神之前救下这些幸存者，再将他们尽数改造为听命于我们、无人知晓的鱼人。”
作家闻言，缓缓直起微侧的身形，面上飞快挂上一层敷衍至极的附和笑意，唇角微微上扬，眼底却毫无半分认同，只剩漠然与算计。他故作惊叹，语气带着刻意拔高的夸赞：“了不起。教授在冷门的科学研究与未知领域探索之中，眼界与实力都远超常人，已然走在了所有人的前面，实在令人敬佩。”
话音落下，他缓缓抬手，指尖捏起一支盛着澄澈透明液体的玻璃试管，微微抬臂，对着头顶洒落的冷白微光轻轻晃动。试管内的液体澄澈通透，随着动作缓缓旋出细碎的涟漪，光影在液面轻轻流转。他抬眼望向神色笃定的达门，目光似笑非笑，藏着深不见底的暗流，慢悠悠开口：“你看，仅凭一支试管、一种特制药剂，便能悄然掌控人心、暗地撬动世间秩序，左右无数人的命运，这构想实在太过奇妙，太过精妙。”
“没错。”达门没有丝毫迟疑，毫不犹豫地点头认可，心神皆沉浸在自己的科研野心之中，全然没有看穿对方眼底暗藏的层层算计与蓄谋已久的反水。
“这般精妙无声的博弈，无需千军万马，仅凭两个人便足以稳稳玩转全局，你从未见过这般局面吧？”作家的话音刚落，语气骤然一转，眼底笑意尽数褪去，手腕猛地翻转，动作干脆利落，没有半分犹豫，将试管中所有的透明液体尽数泼洒在冰冷的地面之上。
液体触地的刹那，剧烈的化学反应骤然爆发，没有丝毫缓冲。大团洁白的浓烟轰然翻涌升腾，如同炸开的白雾浪潮，顺着室内气流飞速直冲穹顶，转瞬之间便铺满了整间实验室的每一处角落。一股浓烈、辛辣刺骨的刺鼻气息瞬间席卷全场，无孔不入地钻入口鼻，压迫着周遭的每一寸空气。
漫天白雾遮挡了所有视线，模糊了眼前的一切，呛人的浓烟让达门忍不住剧烈咳嗽起来，胸腔阵阵发闷，酸涩刺痛的气息堵满鼻腔喉咙，双眼被雾气刺激得无法睁开，视线一片模糊。浓烈的窒息感层层裹挟而来，彻底扰乱了他的呼吸与思绪。
达门心头骤然一紧，浑身神经瞬间紧绷，瞬息之间便洞悉了作家的真实意图，眼底瞬间涌上怒意与焦灼，厉声嘶吼着出声制止：“住手！快住手！别让她趁机跑了！”
可一切都为时已晚。趁着漫天浓烟遮蔽视线、彻底扰乱场内局势的绝佳时机，作家不再伪装，转身便拔腿疾冲。他借着白茫茫雾气的完美掩护，脚步迅捷沉稳，飞速朝着实验室出口逃窜，身形转瞬便融入浓稠的白雾之中，彻底消失在这片迷蒙的雾气里，不留半点踪迹。
场景骤然切换至另一侧。幽暗荒僻的山野之中，阿让带着满心惶恐的波丽一路不停疾奔，脚步匆匆，风声在耳畔飞速掠过。两人穿过丛生的杂草与嶙峋乱石，一路辗转奔波，最终抵达了一处古老肃穆的祭祀场地。
整片场地荒芜寂寥，透着历经岁月沉淀的苍凉与静谧，四周草木稀疏，晚风萧瑟，空气中萦绕着古老又肃穆的苍凉气息。场地中央，一尊巨型石像静静矗立，身躯巍峨厚重，石面布满岁月侵蚀的斑驳痕迹，纹路沧桑厚重。石像面容肃穆庄严，双目俯瞰大地，仿佛静静见证着世间岁月流转，周身弥散着不容亵渎的威严与沉寂。

阿让快步停下奔波的脚步，平稳气息，随即转头看向身侧的波丽。少女眉眼间满是藏不住的惶恐与不安，眼底萦绕着浓浓的忐忑，身形微微紧绷，显然还未从方才的惊险逃亡中缓过神来。阿让放轻了自己的语气，褪去了奔波的急促，变得沉稳又温柔，字字句句都带着十足的笃定，认真安抚道：“你听我的，现在必须立刻找地方藏好，安心待在原地等我过来接你，不用害怕，有我在。”
波丽紧紧攥住衣角，指尖微微泛白，指节紧绷，心底的慌乱层层翻涌。她抬眸望着眼前的阿让，唇瓣微动，眼底满是担忧与顾虑，话到嘴边又反复斟酌，欲言又止：“可是……万一你回来找不到我，或者遇到危险怎么办？”
待四周彻底恢复寂静，波丽才敛好心神，独自缓步走到巨型石像的面庞下方。她抬眸仔细打量着巍峨的石像，又认真环顾四周空旷荒凉的环境，反复确认周遭没有异常动静后，最终弯腰蹲身在石像侧边一处凹陷的隐蔽死角。这里视野隐蔽、不易被察觉，恰好能完美遮挡身形。她紧紧屏住呼吸，敛去所有动静，安安静静地蹲伏在原地，耐心等候着阿让归来。
他抬手随意指了指碗中堆叠的海鲜，继续耐心解释其中的缘由，语气里满是麻木与无奈：“你也看得出来，这片矿区条件简陋，根本没有任何能够长久保鲜的设备与办法。这里气温潮湿闷热，再过几个小时，这些尚且能入口的食材就会彻底腐烂变质、发臭滋生细菌，到时候连这些都没得吃，根本由不得我们挑选。”

（“那女孩逃跑了。”达门看着张佛远去的方向，回了作家一句。
“哦，天啊，真让人沮丧。”作家说。
“我们会把她抓回来的。”达门说。
“哦是的，你当然会的，对你来说很重要，不是吗？”作家在一旁有所指的道。“我是说你，想要所有你能得到的人力，不是吗？”
content_en:
Damen turned his head calmly and calmly met the writer's probing gaze. His eyes were clear and unwavering, without any dodge. His expression was open and indifferent, and there was no trace of any emotional ups and downs. His tone was calm, and he responded calmly: "Yes." After a pause, he added with an indifferent expression, "But these manpower that can be mobilized is cheap, abundant, and available everywhere. Even if you invest all of it, it is not worth pity at all."
During the brief interval between the two men's physical confrontation and verbal exchange, Damen's attention was completely locked on the conversation with each other, and he was not aware of the hidden movements of the person beside him. The writer took advantage of the moment when Damen's eyes met and his mind was focused, and he leaned very slightly sideways against the cold metal experimental table. The table was soaked in chemicals and low temperatures all year round, giving off a biting chill. His fingertips were extremely skillful, so light that there was almost no movement. He quietly picked up a narrow-necked glass bottle with a fine diameter and a completely sealed seal. He then pulled out a clean, soft white handkerchief. He firmly pressed the bottle with his fingertips, tilted it slightly, and slowly and evenly poured the colorless, odorless, clear and special liquid in the bottle onto the cloth of the handkerchief.
The whole set of movements was smooth and flowing, gentle and secretive. The arc of the wrist rotation was extremely small, and the body posture blocked all abnormal movements. The whole process was silent, without any bump or sound. It perfectly covered up all traces and completely deceived Damen beside him.
Damen remained unaware of the secret movement around him, completely immersed in his long-planned transformation plan. His brows were stern, and his tone was absolutely calm, and he clearly stated the core rules of this experiment: "We go deep into the sea area where the shipwreck was lost to search for survivors. The deep-sea environment is changing rapidly and is full of dangers. If we act too late, the people we salvage from the cold seabed will no longer be alive, but will only be cold, stiff, lifeless corpses."
He lowered his eyes slightly, with a trace of paranoid fanaticism flashing in his eyes, and his tone was firm and cold, expressing the ultimate goal of this plan: "And we will do our best to save these survivors before death, and then transform them into fish-men who obey our orders and no one knows."
Upon hearing this, the writer slowly straightened up his slightly sideways figure, and a perfunctory smile of agreement quickly appeared on his face. The corners of his lips were slightly raised, but there was no trace of recognition in his eyes, only indifference and calculation. He pretended to be amazed, and his tone was deliberately high praise: "It's amazing. In the unpopular scientific research and exploration of unknown fields, the professor's vision and strength are far beyond ordinary people. He is already ahead of everyone. It is really admirable."
After the words fell, he slowly raised his hand, picked up a glass test tube containing a clear and transparent liquid with his fingertips, raised his arm slightly, and shook it gently against the cold white light falling above his head. The liquid in the test tube is clear and transparent. With the movement, it slowly spins out fine ripples, and light and shadow gently flow on the liquid surface. He raised his eyes to look at the determined Damen, his eyes half smiling but not smiling, hiding a bottomless undercurrent, and he spoke slowly: "Look, with just a test tube and a special potion, you can quietly control people's hearts, secretly stir up the order of the world, and influence the fate of countless people. This idea is too wonderful and too subtle."
"That's right." Damen nodded without any hesitation. He was so immersed in his own scientific research ambitions that he completely failed to see through the layers of calculations and long-planned betrayal hidden in the other party's eyes.
"Such an exquisite and silent game does not require thousands of troops. Just two people can steadily control the situation. You have never seen such a situation, right?" As soon as the writer finished speaking, his tone suddenly changed. The smile in his eyes faded away. He flipped his wrist suddenly, with a crisp movement without any hesitation, and poured all the transparent liquid in the test tube onto the cold ground.
The moment the liquid touched the ground, a violent chemical reaction suddenly broke out.Not the slightest buffer. A large cloud of thick white smoke suddenly surged up, like an exploding wave of white mist. It followed the airflow in the room and rushed straight to the dome. In an instant, it covered every corner of the entire laboratory. A strong, pungent and pungent smell instantly swept across the entire place, penetrating into the mouth and nose, oppressing every inch of the surrounding air.
The white mist in the sky blocked all sight, blurring everything in front of him. The choking smoke made Damen cough violently, his chest felt tight, and the sour and stinging breath filled his nose and throat. His eyes were so stimulated by the mist that he could not open them, and his vision was blurred. A strong sense of suffocation washed over him, completely disrupting his breathing and thoughts.
Damen's heart suddenly tightened, and all the nerves in his body were tense. In an instant, he understood the writer's true intention. Anger and anxiety surged in his eyes, and he screamed to stop: "Stop! Stop! Don't let her run away!"
But it was too late. Taking advantage of the perfect opportunity when the thick smoke obscured his vision and completely disrupted the situation inside the venue, the writer stopped pretending, turned around and rushed forward. Taking advantage of the perfect cover of the white fog, he quickly and steadily fled towards the exit of the laboratory. In an instant, his figure melted into the thick white fog and completely disappeared in this misty fog, leaving no trace.
The scene suddenly switches to the other side. In the dark and desolate mountains, Arang and Polly, who was full of fear, kept running all the way, with hurried steps and the sound of wind rushing past his ears. The two walked through thickets of weeds and jagged rocks, and finally arrived at an ancient and solemn sacrificial site.
The entire site is desolate and lonely, showing the desolation and tranquility accumulated over the years. The surrounding vegetation is sparse, the evening breeze is bleak, and the air is filled with an ancient and solemn desolation. In the center of the site, a giant stone statue stands quietly, with a majestic and thick body. The stone surface is covered with mottled traces of erosion over time, and the lines are thick and vicissitudes of life. The stone statue has a solemn face, and its eyes overlook the earth, as if it is quietly witnessing the passage of time in the world, and its whole body is filled with majesty and silence that cannot be blasphemed.

Arang quickly stopped running around, calmed his breathing, and then turned to look at Polly beside him. The girl's brows and eyes were full of uncontrollable fear and uneasiness, and her eyes were filled with deep anxiety. Her body was slightly tense, and it was obvious that she had not recovered from the thrilling escape just now. Arang softened his tone, lost the rush of running around, and became calm and gentle. Every word was full of certainty, and he conscientiously comforted: "You listen to me. Now you must find a place to hide immediately. Stay where you are and wait for me to pick you up. Don't be afraid, I am here."
Polly clenched the corners of her clothes tightly, her fingertips turned slightly white, her knuckles were tense, and panic surged in her heart. She raised her eyes and looked at Ah Rang in front of her, her lips moved slightly, her eyes were full of worries and worries, she thought over her words again and again, but hesitated: "But... what if you can't find me when you come back, or you are in danger?"
When the surroundings were completely silent, Polly gathered her thoughts and walked slowly to the bottom of the giant stone statue alone. She raised her eyes and looked at the towering stone statue carefully, and then carefully looked around the empty and desolate environment. After repeatedly confirming that there was no abnormal movement around her, she finally bent down and squatted in a sunken and hidden corner on the side of the stone statue. The view here is hidden and difficult to detect, and it can perfectly block the body shape. She held her breath tightly, suppressed all movement, and crouched quietly on the spot, patiently waiting for Arang's return.
He raised his hand and pointed casually at the seafood stacked in the bowl, and continued to patiently explain the reason, his tone full of numbness and helplessness: "You can also see that the conditions in this mining area are simple, and there is no equipment or method to keep fresh for a long time. The temperature here is humid and hot, and in a few hours, these ingredients that can still be eaten will beIt will completely rot, become stinky, and breed bacteria. When the time comes, we won’t even be able to eat these things, and we won’t be able to choose at all. "
("The girl ran away." Damen looked at the direction Zhang Fo was going and replied to the writer.
“Oh, my God, it’s so frustrating,” the writer said.
"We'll get her back," Damen said.
"Oh yes, of course you will, it's very important to you, isn't it?" The writer pointed to the side. "I mean you, want all the manpower you can get, don't you?"
